summary: ACDE #230 梳理 Hegotá 执行层头号候选：LUCID 加密交易池已介绍、2 月 18 日开专场，EIP-8141 frame 交易的执行规范实现与测试进行中，另有 EIP-8105 加密交易池与 EIP-7807 SSZ 执行区块；客户端团队需在下次 ACDE 前写出偏好，再下一次决定。bal-devnet-3 范围包括 EIP-8037 与 EIP-7954。首次 L1 zkEVM 专场举行。

items.topic: Hegotá 头号提案：AA 与加密内存池
items.title: ACDE #230
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #11：执行层头号候选包括 LUCID 加密交易池（已介绍，2 月 18 日专场）、EIP-8141 frame 交易（执行规范实现与测试进行中）、EIP-8105 通用协议内加密内存池 与 EIP-7807 SSZ 执行区块；客户端团队在下次 ACDE 前写出偏好（含不设执行层头号的选项），再下一次 ACDE 决定。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #11: execution layer headliner candidates are the LUCID encrypted transaction pool (presented, breakout February 18), EIP-8141 frame transaction (execution spec implementation and tests in progress), EIP-8105 universal enshrined encrypted mempool and EIP-7807 SSZ execution blocks; client teams will write up preferences, including no execution layer headliner, for the next ACDE with a decision at the one after.
items.topic_en: Hegotá headliners: AA and encrypted mempools

items.title: EIP-8037
items.note: ACDE #230 确定 bal-devnet-3 范围：eth_simulateV1、EIP-8037 状态创建成本、EIP-7954 合约大小与 EIP-7975 eth/70 部分区块收据列表（83M 以上 gas limit 所需）；eth/71 将加入后续 devnet。
items.note_en: ACDE #230 set bal-devnet-3 scope: eth_simulateV1, EIP-8037 state creation cost, EIP-7954 contract size and EIP-7975 eth/70 partial block receipt lists (needed for a gas limit above 83M); eth/71 joins a later devnet.

keywords_en: ACDE #230 lists Hegotá execution layer headliner candidates LUCID
eth/71 Block Access List Exchange EIP-8159
summary_en: ACDE #230 reviewed Hegotá execution layer headliner candidates: LUCID's encrypted pool was presented with a breakout on February 18, EIP-8141 frame transaction spec implementation and tests are in progress, and EIP-8105 encrypted pool and EIP-7807 SSZ execution blocks are also in the running; client teams will write up preferences for the next ACDE, with a decision the call after. bal-devnet-3 scope includes EIP-8037 and EIP-7954. The first L1-zkEVM breakout took place.
